d:
In northeast Delhi’s Mustafabad, Form 7 applications have been filed to delete the names of voters from the electoral rolls, even though they continue to live at their registered addresses.
The objections, filed during the ongoing Special Intensive Revision, cite reasons such as “absent or permanently shifted” and “death”.
According to Election Commission records, the applications were filed by BJP-appointed booth-level agents.
In polling booth number 129 in Dayalpur, all 28 voters whose names were proposed for deletion were found living at their registered addresses The Hindu’s visit.
